Welcome!

/v/MartianColonist is a sub for discussion and ideas about the long term human habitation on Mars. The place to discuss the why's and how's of humans living on the planet Mars. Also to discuss general science and technology issues that would / could be directly related to human habitation of Mars.

Just off the top of my head possible topics might be, 1.) Plans for a city on Mars... be it conventional or speculative, 2.) Possible problems or difficulties faced by the humans living or working on Mars, 3.) Technical aspects (life in a hostile environment / how to use local resources / how and where to build the first city / methods of construction / benefits and pitfalls of lower gravity on Mars / UV radiation and CMEs [coronal mass ejections] / thin atmosphere on Mars... the good and the bad / issues with Martian dust storms and possible solutions). But that is only scratching the surface really.

This subverse is meant for:

  • All those interested in the topic of the Human habitation of Mars.
  • If you want to live on Mars
  • You who are interested in space colonization in general
  • And of course anyone who has (or wants to) signed on to any of the various lists of people who want to go to Mars

I hope to make this a place to share ideas and information, but also for constructive criticism so we all expand our knowledge and understanding of the issues involved. Let me repeat: Constructive Criticism.

The focus of this sub is human life on Mars. Discussions about various spacecraft propulsion systems would be better posted over at /v/Space. If you wish to discuss colonizing other worlds besides Mars, well, find that subverse and post there unless a strong case can be made for your post having direct application to the creation of or life in a future Mars city.

Other thoughts: Be nice, treat others as you would want to be treated, and most of all Have Fun !!!
